verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt is served (HTTP 200) at doc.babylonjs.com, and both doc.babylonjs.com and www.babylonjs.com serve llms.txt files. Its entries index the documentation by topic, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Missing for 10: per-page Markdown mirrors (the docs pages are client-rendered Next.js with no .md versions), and any evidence of an llms-full.txt or deeper agent-specific guidance beyond the high-level topic index.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://doc.babylonjs.com/llms.txt # Babylon.js Documentation
BOTH doc.babylonjs.com and www.babylonjs.com serve llms.txt files
